messages:
sasha: quick flag  i ran accessibility lint on the quickstart landing rail (the horizontal sample-projects strip). flagged issues: focusable cards missing outline, low contrast tag badges in dark mode, and inconsistent keyboard order.

marcus: thanks. can you paste the report? iirc the strip was a new pattern from the last sprint.

sasha: pasted the main failures here: 
1) .project-card: outline:none on focus (should use token focus-ring)
2) .tag-badge (dark): #6b6b6b on #0b0b0b => AA fail for small text
3) keyboard: tab cycles into CTA then into the overflow chevron; UX expects card-level focus then children.

elena: UX intent: we wanted card to be focusable as a single unit with Enter opening the sample app, and inner focusable controls (actions) reachable via arrow/right arrow. we can implement roving tabindex for inner controls.

ravi: engineering note: roving tabindex is doable but slightly complex with current list virtualization. alternative is make each card a single interactive element and move actions into a contextual menu opened by long-press / ellipsis. simpler for keyboard but less discoverable.

maria: copy question: the badge text says "community" vs "Redwood sample" in some variants. prefer consistent naming "Sample project (community)"? also need string for screenreader-only context.

elena: prefer "Sample project  community"? (that middle char is a separator placeholder). actually simpler: "Sample project — community". screenreader label should be "Open sample project: <name>".

sasha: +1. also add aria-describedby pointing to the short description paragraph under the title. avoids reading long subtitle.

marcus: small design tweak: reduce image height from 120px to 88px to keep cards compact on mobile. that should reduce vertical overflow with banner.

ravi: impl constraints: virtualization currently measures cards by height. reducing image will require updating measurement buffer but fine. will add ticket ENG-4602.

elena: animation note: when user tabs into the strip, we should not auto-scroll the carousel; keep position stable to avoid motion for keyboard users.

sasha: test plan: focus outline visible at 3px offset, badge color token change to --text-muted-2 for dark mode, roving tabindex OR single interactive card approach, aria-describedby for descriptions, no auto-scroll on focus, keyboard order test matrix.

maria: analytics & experiment ask: we want to run a small A/B on CTA wording: variant A "Create sample project" vs variant B "Try sample project". track clicks and conversion to completing first-run checklist. can someone add experiment flags?

marcus: i'll wire flags. please give me the experiment keys and expected metric names.

maria: keys: quickstart_rail_cta_v1/v2. metric: quickstart_sample_project_started (boolean), quickstart_onboarding_completed. event spec in the doc.

elena: microcopy: success toast after creating sample -> "Sample project ready — Open quickstart" (keeps action visible). earlier we used "Project created" but that's ambiguous.

sasha: accessibility follow-up: add screenreader-only hint that the strip has inline keyboard controls: "Use arrow keys to navigate sample projects" when focused.

ravi: note about mobile: overflow chevron should be reachable as separate control; ensure large hit target (44px).

marcus: plan: i'll push a small layout PR today to clamp image height + focus styles. ravi will open ENG-4602 for virtualization changes. sasha/elena/maria can QA Wed 10am PT.

ux-bot: reminder: accessibility checklist required for all feature rollouts. please attach completed checklist to PR.

maria: perfect. small ask: can everyone drop final copy tweaks in the doc by EOD so i18n can start?

elena: done.

sasha: will run another lint after marcus' PR.

marcus: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/web/pull/2824 (WIP) — notes in the description. pinging thread for review when ready. :rocket:
